attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 (RHEL 10) into a single RabbitMQ 4.3.5 cluster (Erlang/OTP 27), created the payments vhost with a durable quorum queue "orders" and an appuser application account scoped to that vhost with full publish/consume permissions. Demonstrated that durable messages survive the loss of any one node and remain consumable from the remaining nodes, then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, verifying changed boot identities and full cluster/data recovery after each.
